title: Tlolomolao ya Lebopo
intro: O eme mo motlhabeng wa lebopo le le lebetsweng, kwa makhubu a sebasebang a setšhaba se se lekilweng ke taelo ya bomodimo. Mowa o bokete ka kgakologelo ya tlolomolao e e neng ya baka phetogo e e gakgamatsang. Meya eno e ne e le bomang, mme teko ya bone e ne e le ya mofuta ofe?
clues: Re ne re le morafe o o neng wa amogela taelo e e tlhamaletseng go tswa go Morena wa rona, le fa go ntse jalo re ne ra bona ditsela tsa go e ganetsa.
Re ne re nna gaufi le metsi mangwe, mme botshelo jwa rona bo ne bo ikaegile ka dibopiwa tsa teng.
Teko e ne ya tla mo go rona ka letsatsi le re neng ra laelwa gore re ikgaphe mo dilong tsa lefatshe.
Dibopiwa tsa metsi di ne tsa tla kwa go rona ka bontsi ka lone letsatsi leo, tsa re raela go feta boitshoko.
Re ne ra loga leano la boferefere la go tila thulaganyo ya bomodimo, re akanya gore re ka feta taelo eo ka botlhale.
Tlolo ya rona e ne ya dira gore re fetoge ka tsela e e tlhabisang ditlhong; re ne ra nna ditshwene tse di nyatsegang ka taelo ya ga Allah.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
